summary: API defects: oversized notes are being accepted and surfaced, and 429 responses are missing Retry-After; tests also need updating for closed-case note status and shared fixture note_count, while one orders timeout looks environmental.

evidence: Observed response body text was "… [4001 characters in total]".
Contract clause: "The note text is longer than 4000 characters, or is missing or empty" returns "422" and "4000 is accepted; 4001 is not (STORY-4488)."
verdicts.action: Fix note creation to reject 4001-character text with 422.

evidence: Observed status was "200" with a note at index 0 whose text was "… [4001 characters in total]".
Contract clause: Note schema property "text" has "type: string" and "maxLength": 4000.
verdicts.action: Prevent oversized note text from being returned in notes listings by enforcing or repairing note length constraints.

verdicts.case_name: orders rate limit trips on request 101
evidence: Expected header "Retry-After"; observed headers were only "content-type: application/json".
Contract clause: "Every 429 carries a Retry-After header." and 429 response header "Retry-After" is "required: true".
verdicts.duplicate_of: orders: 101 calls in a minute is rate limited, with Retry-After
verdicts.action: Return the required Retry-After header on 429 rate-limit responses.

verdicts.case_name: orders: 101 calls in a minute is rate limited, with Retry-After
evidence: Expected header "Retry-After"; observed headers were only "content-type: application/json".
Contract clause: "Every 429 carries a Retry-After header." and 429 response header "Retry-After" is "required: true".
verdicts.action: Return the required Retry-After header on 429 rate-limit responses.

verdicts.case_name: orders: a second customer's orders are readable
evidence: Observed status was "null" and runner reason was "the request never completed: ReadTimeout".
Contract clause checked: GET /cases/{case_id}/orders defines application responses "200", "400", "429", and "404"; no timeout behavior is specified.
verdicts.action: Investigate the timeout in the test environment and rerun this case.

verdicts.case_name: notes: adding a note to a closed case returns 400
evidence: Contract clause: POST /cases/{case_id}/notes response "409": "The case is closed. A closed case is read-only and accepts no new notes (STORY-4520)."
verdicts.action: Update the test to expect 409 for adding a note to a closed case.

verdicts.case_name: case: a fresh case reports note_count 0
evidence: Contract clause: "A case reports note_count, the number of notes currently on it."
verdicts.action: Update the test setup or expectation so CASE-1001 note_count reflects the current number of notes, not a fresh-case assumption.
